properties.title: Slovakia rejects EU’s plan to lock in Russia sanctions for 12 months
properties.summary: BRUSSELS — The Slovak government on Wednesday rejected a 12-month extension for the EU’s individual sanctions package against Russia, three diplomats told POLITICO. The measures — which have already been extended by six months many times before — expire on Sept. 15 . The bloc had hoped to secure a longer extension and avoid repeated renegotiations, but any amendment requires the unanimous support of all 27 member countries. properties.summary: Slovenia’s parliament on Wednesday allowed prosecutors to pursue a criminal case against former Prime Minister Robert Golob over allegations that he improperly meddled in police staffing after taking office in 2022. All 75 lawmakers present — including Golob himself — voted against granting him parliamentary immunity, allowing proceedings to move forward.
